integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, begin from the exact subject identity, wardrobe, environment, lighting, camera angle, framing, pose, object placement, and spatial relationships established by <Picture 1>. Build one continuous shot with no cut. The principal subject initiates the concrete action described for the selected keyframes while the camera follows with a smooth tracking move at a measured speed. Preserve anatomy, materials, scale, contact points, screen direction, and lighting continuity throughout the transition. Every intermediate movement must visibly connect the opening state to the ending state: limbs and handled objects travel through plausible arcs, clothing and hair respond with restrained secondary motion, background parallax matches the camera path, and no object appears, disappears, or teleports. During the final second, progressively reduce the remaining differences in pose, camera position, framing, object state, background alignment, and illumination, landing exactly on the subject placement, composition, and visual state established by <Picture 2> at the final frame. Replace this generic action path in the Scene Prompt Editor with the actual motion that connects your two selected images before rendering.

overall_soundscape: Continuous environmental room tone appropriate to the two keyframes, with synchronized footsteps, fabric movement, handled-object sounds, and spatial reflections matching the visible action. Avoid abrupt ambience changes at the beginning or end.
